title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Low-Mileage Addition to Wear Forgiveness
content:
**Lease-end schedule note — low-mileage addition, Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Rule.** The wear forgiveness low-mileage addition is $150 (the high low-mileage addition) when the miles driven fall short of the mileage allowance by at least 3000 miles (the low-mileage margin); it is $75 (the standard low-mileage addition) when the miles driven fall short of that allowance by less than 3000 miles; it is nothing when the miles driven reach or exceed that allowance. The addition is added to the wear forgiveness cap of the turn-in before the wear forgiveness is measured against that enlarged limit.

**The two quantities**

- *Miles driven*: the turn-in odometer reading less the odometer reading at delivery.
- *Mileage allowance for this addition*: the annual mileage allowance times the sum of the lease term in months and the extension months granted on the lease's maturity extensions, divided by 12. No rounding is applied to it here.

**Boundaries (hypothetical lease: 12000 miles a year, 36-month term, no extensions; allowance 36000 miles)**

| Miles driven | Short of the allowance by | Low-mileage addition |
|---|---|---|
| 32000 | 4000 | $150 |
| 33000 | 3000 | $150 |
| 33001 | 2999 | $75 |
| 35999 | 1 | $75 |
| 36000 | 0 | nothing |
| 38500 | (over) | nothing |

**Hypothetical illustration with an extension**: a lease at 10000 miles a year for 36 months, extended by 3 months in two grants of 2 and 1 months, has an allowance here of 10000 times 39 divided by 12, that is 32500 miles; at 29000 miles driven it falls short by 3500 and takes $150.
